content.short: Chainrails accepts crypto, card, Apple Pay and bank payments through one integration.
content.description: Chainrails accepts crypto on any supported chain, card, Apple Pay, bank transfer or a local fiat rail, all through one integration. Underneath it handles provider selection, ramps, swaps, bridging, routing and settlement, so the integrator does not maintain separate relationships for each. Withdrawals run the same way, paying users out across chains, tokens and fiat without the merchant sourcing liquidity itself. A dashboard reports volume, revenue and performance, with control over API keys and webhooks. A liquidity orchestration feature in development will route through stablecoin rails such as USD to CNGN to NGN.
